capability: OpenPoly experimental Tg ML baseline: 441 polymers × 212 raw Bemis-Murcko scaffolds. Rigorously tests Ridge / Random Forest / HistGradientBoostingRegressor on Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 512 bits) + log10(MW) under scaffold-safe 80/20 held-out AND 212-fold LOSO-CV. Direct apples-to-apples comparison with Push #25 physics-Ridge baseline (MAE = 70.42 K on same polymers). Best ML model = RandomForest (holdout MAE = 42.21 K, R² = +0.001); best LOSO = RandomForest (MAE = 51.24 K, R² = +0.405, vs physics-Ridge 70.42 K = +19.18 K, +27.2% relative). Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
